data.title: Kaia
data.about:
Welcome to Kaia by Emaar at The Valley, a luxurious collection of large-sized townhouses, meticulously designed to redefine modern family living. With spacious 3 and 4-bedroom layouts, these homes seamlessly combine comfort, sophistication, and practicality. Kaia Homes offers thoughtfully tailored 3 and 4-bedroom residences, uniquely designed in two distinct styles – Plex6 and Plex8. 

Nestled within the serene ambiance of The Valley, Kaia offers residents a peaceful retreat from the city's hustle, surrounded by lush green landscapes and community-friendly amenities—an idyllic environment for relaxation and bonding. Residents are treated to world-class amenities, including a state-of-the-art fitness center, a pet park, and pools, curated to inspire an active and vibrant lifestyle.

characteristics_module.title: Kaia at The Valley: Where Luxury Meets Serenity
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Spacious Houses: Large-sized 3 and 4-bedroom layouts designed for modern family living.
  • Prime Location: Strategically situated along Dubai-Al Ain Road with easy access to key landmarks.
  • World-Class Amenities: Parks, swimming pools, sports facilities, retail outlets, and more for an elevated lifestyle.
  • Tranquil Surroundings: Nestled in lush green landscapes, offering a peaceful retreat from city life.
  • Family-Friendly Design: A community-focused environment with family-centric amenities and spaces.
  • Luxury and Practicality: Seamless blend of elegant designs and functional layouts for a refined living experience.
  • Investment Opportunity: Starting at AED 2.72M, Kaia offers excellent value in one of Dubai’s most sought-after communities.

location_tile.title: The Valley: A Tranquil Suburban Retreat.
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Kaia at The Valley enjoys a prime location along the Dubai-Al Ain Road, providing seamless connectivity to major landmarks and hubs across Dubai. Just a short drive from key destinations like Downtown Dubai, Dubai Outlet Mall, and Global Village, residents can easily access world-class shopping, dining, and entertainment options. The strategic location offers the perfect balance between urban convenience and a serene suburban lifestyle, making it an ideal choice for families and professionals alike.

  • 15 Minutes - Dubai International Airport
  • 20 Minutes -  Downtown Dubai
  • 20 Minutes - Dubai Marina
  • 20 Minutes - Global Village

seo.metaTitle: Kaia by Emaar at The Valley
seo.metaDescription: Unveiling tranquil living in Kaia at The Valley, 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses developed by Emaar Properties.

more_info.answer: Kaia is located in The Valley, a picturesque community in Dubai known for its tranquil natural setting, vibrant green spaces, and expansive landscapes.
more_info.question: Where is Kaia Homes located?

more_info.answer: Kaia at the Valley offers seamless connectivity to major destinations, including Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Dubai International Airport.
more_info.question: What key destinations are accessible from Kaia at The Valley?

more_info.answer: Kaia features 3 and 4-bedroom residences with two distinct façade options: stylish Plex6 and unique Plex8 designs, crafted for modern family living.
more_info.question: What types of units are available at Kaia?

more_info.answer: Amenities include a state-of-the-art fitness center, indoor multipurpose room, pet park, community parks, landscaped pool deck, outdoor play areas, a dedicated kids' playground, and expansive green spaces.
more_info.question: What amenities are included at Kaia by Emaar?

more_info.answer: Prices begin at AED 2.72 million for 3-bedroom homes and AED 3.29 million for 4-bedroom homes.
more_info.question: What are the starting prices for homes at Kaia?

more_info.answer: The payment plan includes an initial 10% down payment in January 2025, followed by scheduled instalments aligned with construction milestones, and a final 20% payment upon completion in July 2028.
more_info.question: What is the payment plan for Kaia at The Valley?

more_info.answer: The Valley offers a peaceful lifestyle with vibrant green spaces, expansive landscapes, and access to schools, leisure activities, and essential amenities, blending modern living with natural surroundings.
more_info.question: What makes The Valley a unique community?

more_info.answer: Yes, Kaia Homes offers excellent investment potential with its serene living environment, world-class amenities, and strategic location, all developed by the trusted Emaar Properties.
